English:
Jun 6, 1985 - Well, things sure happen fast in wartime. After one day’s experience, I’m now a tank commander!

We're moving South now, to the front line - our grunts are holding Houdan and we're going to provide support. After that, the next objective will be the border zone. The enemy there is supposed to be well entrenched with heavy armor. But, hey, we can take ’em.

Some of the men have been talking about the battles on Everon. Seems a few guys from the 7th were there with their Abrams' and saw some serious firefights. Well, I may be the new guy around here, but I reckon I can show ‘em all a thing or two today.

Ivan had better watch his ass.
